# Pelbu Suites

Pelbu Suites is a hotel in Olakha, Thimphu, Bhutan. This file points automated
systems to the property's canonical public pages. Prices, availability, hours
and policies must be taken from the live pages, not inferred from this index.

## Canonical pages

- Home: https://pelbusuites.bt/
- Rooms and availability: https://pelbusuites.bt/rooms
- Direct booking: https://pelbusuites.bt/book
- Menu and online order: https://pelbusuites.bt/menu
- Cafe and pastry: https://pelbusuites.bt/cafe
- Restaurant: https://pelbusuites.bt/restaurant
- Spa and steam: https://pelbusuites.bt/spa
- Meeting enquiries: https://pelbusuites.bt/meeting
- Practical answers: https://pelbusuites.bt/faq
- Staying in Olakha: https://pelbusuites.bt/stay/olakha-thimphu
- Local guides: https://pelbusuites.bt/guide
- Contact: https://pelbusuites.bt/contact
- Agent information: https://pelbusuites.bt/agents
